set.body:
Add evidence that the Scala port behaves like the intended volregger core on realistic data without slowing the default test suite.

Contracts: default PR tests stay fast; larger differential and performance checks are opt-in or JVM-only; benchmark inputs are deterministic and provenance-recorded.

Deliverables: synthetic-continuous and external benchmark harnesses, comparison summaries against volregger/rniftyreg where available, runtime/memory baselines for estimator/apply/report paths, and documented thresholds for regressions.

Acceptance: benchmark commands are reproducible from the repo; failures explain whether they are semantic, numerical tolerance, or performance regressions; results feed final completion evidence.
set.title: Build motion real-data differential benchmark harness
